RateLimits.//: Server-side per-IP throttles. PermitLimit requests per WindowSeconds; a 429 is returned once exceeded. Tune per deployment.

Jwt.//: DEV secret only. In production set Jwt__Secret via an env var / secret, min 32 chars.

Fiscal.//: Provider: None | Sandbox | FBR | PRA. Sandbox simulates fiscal registration for the demo. For FBR/PRA set Endpoint/Token/PosId from your enrolment.

Payments.//: Provider: Mock | JazzCash. Set Provider=JazzCash and fill MerchantId/Password/IntegritySalt from your JazzCash kit to go live.
